investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Mervid Trips (travel booking); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1 (zones europe-west1-b/europe-west1-c/europe-west1-d); network range 10.180.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster mervid-prod-europe (GKE); Automation: an in-house node-recycler controller rotates worker nodes (cordon, drain, terminate, replace) in batches bounded by maxUnavailable (20% of 24 nodes); runs are recorded with RECYCLE- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
